//: Compiles the pure domain core + tests to CommonJS so `node --test` can run them with no test framework dependency. Modules free of Next.js are what is included here — the engine, policy, catalog, SS-4 mapping and provider clients are deliberately pure so they stay unit-testable. db.ts is the one deliberate exception: it imports better-sqlite3 and opens the deployment's real file, and it is here because where that file lands is worth a test rather than a promise. It pulls in `paths.ts` with it, which is pure and is the single answer to 'where does this deployment keep its data'.
